about: The Workbench icons of the XMoto drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is X-Moto's own program icon (extra/xmoto.png). XMoto-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, XMoto.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's XMoto.info. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (data, its Textures, Musics and Fonts, and userdata): the Makefile copies it to each name.
